dogecoin.text:
@brightxpoison @nemezios @BriannaWu I retract my original statement, and have deleted it to prevent the further spread of misinformation.

However, Dogecoin still has the problems I have cited.
@brightxpoison @nemezios @BriannaWu So, as long as Dogecoin continues to be mined at its full rate, it has a modest maximum rate of inflation? That’s  similar to a fiat currency in a growing economy.

@NaomiKritzer @ArtusBunnyBane A VPN doesn’t help. Location tracking and purchase tracking goes on whether or not you have a VPN. Leave your smartphone home, pay cash when you’re out, use Dogecoin instead of credit cards, that would help, but that, too, has its price.
